CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD ='Microsoftpassword@123';


--------------------------------
-- DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL
--------------------------------

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL roshan_creds
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';


-- -----------------------
-- -- EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
-- -----------------------
-- DROP EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE silver_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://azurefundaroshanstorage.blob.core.windows.net/dwhsynpse/silver/',
    CREDENTIAL = roshan_creds 
);


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE gold_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://azurefundaroshanstorage.blob.core.windows.net/dwhsynpse/gold/',
    CREDENTIAL = roshan_creds
);

-----------------------
-- EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT
-----------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT delta
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
);
